steps: Cook rice in water in a small saucepan over medium heat for 18 minutes, until tender; set aside.
Peel and finely dice the onion; mince the garlic cloves.
Trim the zucchini and slice into thin half-moons about 5 mm thick.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook for 3 minutes, until translucent.
Add zucchini slices; cook for 4 minutes, stirring, until slightly softened.
Stir in drained white beans, crushed tomatoes, dried basil and oregano.
Simmer uncovered for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens.
Serve over rice, mashing beans and zucchini slightly for younger babies.
Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 1 month.
